company.name: Fleetzero
company.shortDescription: Fleetzero is building battery electric cargo ships to affordably decarbonize ocean freight.
company.description:
To deliver freight for our customers, Fleetzero is developing a fleet of electric ships without any green bonus. The company's vessels, unlike giant container ships, can be built inexpensively in domestic shipyards, which enables us to operate in regulated markets where ships must be built in the country they are traveling through.

Fleetzero was established in 2021 in Auburn, Alabama.

aiResearchSummary.text: Fleetzero is focused on developing a containerized battery system designed for integration into cargo ships. This system includes a container, framework, battery cells, and an electrical coupling, allowing for easy installation and removal from a vessel's container space. The framework within the container defines multiple compartments, facilitating efficient energy storage and management. This innovation aligns with Fleetzero's goal of creating battery electric cargo ships to decarbonize ocean freight.
